settings.question: Why does it take 8 to 10 weeks?
settings.answer: Because nothing is made until you order it. Your mattress is built to your chosen size, flown to the UK, and cleared through customs. This is how made-to-order furniture works - the same wait you would expect from a bespoke sofa. Many orders arrive sooner.

settings.question: Can I change my mind after ordering?
settings.answer: Yes. Cancel any time before your mattress is dispatched and we refund you in full, no questions asked. Once it arrives you still have 100 nights.

settings.question: What if it is late?
settings.answer: We give a delivery window rather than a single date because international freight can move. If we are going to miss the window we will tell you before you find out, and you can cancel for a full refund at any point before dispatch.

settings.question: What if I do not like it?
settings.answer: You have 100 nights to decide. If it is not right we collect it and refund you.

settings.question: How much is a comfort top?
settings.answer:
GBP 250. A new mattress does not cost GBP 250, which is the point - you refresh the layer that wears rather than replacing the whole bed.

The same top works on any other mattress as a 10cm topper, so it is not only useful to people who own ours.

settings.question: Is the price negotiable?
settings.answer: No. We sell direct and price the same for everyone, which is how the price stays where it is.

settings.question: Do I pay in full today?
settings.answer: Yes. You pay the full mattress price at checkout. You can spread the cost with Klarna, Tabby or Tamara where available. Cancel any time before dispatch for a full refund.

settings.question: How does the split payment work?
settings.answer: You pay part today to place the order. The balance is due before dispatch. Cancel any time before dispatch for a full refund of amounts paid.

settings.question: Which size should I choose?
settings.answer: Use the size selector on this page - dimensions are always shown in cm. UAE and UK sizes differ (a UAE King is wider than a UK King). See the size guide for a full comparison.

settings.question: How does the replaceable top work?
settings.answer: Unzip, lift out, swap in when the comfort layer is worn. To change firmness, flip the module inside - you do not need a new top.

settings.question: What does it feel like?
settings.answer: You choose. The comfort module inside has a softer face and a firmer face - flip it to change. Soft suits side sleepers and lighter frames; firm suits back and front sleepers and heavier frames. If you are used to a very soft mattress, either setting will feel firmer for the first week or so while your body adjusts.

settings.question: How do I change the firmness?
settings.answer: Open the zip on the side of the mattress, lift out the comfort module, turn it over and put it back. Two minutes, no tools. One side is softer, the other is firmer. You can do it as often as you like and it costs nothing.

settings.question: What if my partner and I want different firmnesses?
settings.answer: The flip changes the whole mattress, not one side of it, so you will need to agree. Most couples find one setting works once they have both slept on it for a fortnight. If you cannot agree, tell us within your 100 nights and we will collect it and refund you in full.

settings.question: Will my mattress look exactly like the photographs?
settings.answer:
Close, but not identical. Every mattress is hand-assembled and fabrics are sourced in batches, so the shade of the cover or the side panel can vary very slightly between runs. It is the same difference you would see between two lengths of the same cloth.

What never varies is what is inside it. The spring unit, the comfort layers, the depth, the firmness and the construction are identical in every mattress we make, to the same specification.

If yours arrives and you are not happy with it for any reason, including how it looks, you have 100 nights to tell us and we will collect it and refund you in full.

settings.question: Will I feel my partner moving?
settings.answer:
Much less than on a conventional sprung mattress. Every spring is individually wrapped in its own pocket, so it compresses on its own rather than pulling its neighbours with it. Add 10cm of foam above that and most movement is absorbed before it reaches you.

It is not complete isolation - no sprung mattress is - but if you are currently woken every time your partner turns over, this will be a noticeable change.

settings.title: Measure the sleeping surface
settings.body: Strip the sheets. Measure the mattress itself — width × length — with a tape in centimetres. Do not measure the outer bed frame or headboard.

settings.title: Or measure the base
settings.body: If you are buying for a new bed, measure the usable bed base or slatted area (inside the rails). That is the footprint your mattress must fill.

settings.title: Match width × length
settings.body: Find the listed size whose cm dimensions match your measurement. Ignore marketing names if the centimetres disagree — order by the numbers.

settings.title: Between sizes or custom?
settings.body: If nothing lines up, use Request a size and we will discuss options, lead time, and pricing with you on WhatsApp.

settings.heading: Measure in centimetres. Order the size that matches.
settings.lede: Size names differ by market. A UAE King is not a UK King. Always trust the centimetre dimensions — not the label on the tag.
